harvest_moon.name: Harvest Moon
harvest_moon.description: Full moon closest to the autumnal equinox (around September 22-23)

hunters_moon.name: Hunter's Moon
hunters_moon.description: Full moon following the Harvest Moon

blue_moon_monthly.name: Blue Moon
blue_moon_monthly.description: Second full moon in a calendar month

blue_moon_seasonal.name: Blue Moon
blue_moon_seasonal.description: Third full moon in an astronomical season with four full moons

supermoon.name: Supermoon
supermoon.description: Full moon that occurs when the Moon is at or near its closest approach to Earth (within 90% of perigee)

notes.source: Traditional Native American and Colonial American moon names
notes.priority_system: Higher priority names override lower priority names. Harvest Moon (100) overrides month names. Blue Moon (80) overrides month names but not Harvest/Hunter's Moon.
notes.supermoon_note: Supermoon is an additional descriptor, not a replacement name
